translation: The Chong [vessel] is the sea of the channels and vessels, also called the sea of blood. Its vessel, together with the Ren vessel, both arise within the uterus in the lower abdomen. Its superficial and external [branch] arises at Qichong (ST30). (Also named Qijie; located in the pubic hair region of the lower abdomen, two cun on each side, at the two ends of the pubic bone, in the hollow where the artery pulses; a Foot-Yangming point.) It runs between the two channels of Foot-Yangming and Foot-Shaoyin, ascending along the abdomen to Henggu (KI11).
